title: Dedication
text: Oh, you guys. I’ve said this a bajillion times now. These books can’t exist without you. Patreon. Reddit. You guys in prison. That lady at the coffee shop who hates the anti Cocker Spaniel sticker on the back of my laptop. All of you are the best. Well, almost all of you. Dwight… in the immortal words of Princess Donut near the end of this book. “It’s okay to be a work in progress.”
